description: Reduce DEPTH from 8 to 6 (model dim 384, 3 heads at HEAD_DIM 128) so the model gets more steps in 300 s.
Replace the linear LR warmdown with a cosine-shaped warmdown, keeping the warmdown ratio at 0.5.
Clip gradient norm to 1.0 before optimizer.step to reduce loss spikes.
No change: the optimizer is a custom MuonAdamW whose AdamW step is already a torch.compile-fused kernel, so there is no fused=True flag to set.
Halve the lm_head init std from 0.001 to 0.0005 so initial logits are smaller.
Lower Muon cautious weight decay from 0.2 to 0.1.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 so the learning rate warms up linearly over the first 3% of the time budget.

issues: Integrity is fine. The diff only changes the Muon momentum schedule: the warmup is now 100 steps instead of 300, the peak is 0.97 instead of 0.95, and momentum blends linearly toward 0.9 during the warmdown, which is based on time progress. It does not touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines or the evaluation call.

No bug found that would make the result meaningless. The function signature and its call site are updated together. The weight w goes from 0 to 1 over the warmdown window, so momentum stays between 0.85 and 0.97. WARMDOWN_RATIO is already used by the LR schedule.

z cannot be recomputed exactly because the incumbent standard deviation is not given. The difference is 1.1194 - 1.1146 = +0.0048 (the candidate is worse). The reported z of -0.879 is consistent with an incumbent standard deviation of about 0.0055, using a sign convention where negative means worse. The sign and the reject decision agree with the numbers.
There is only one candidate run, so the evidence is weak, but it points toward the candidate being worse. Rejecting it is reasonable.

description: Ramp Muon momentum from 0.85 to 0.97 over the first 100 steps, hold it until the warmdown starts, then decay it linearly to 0.9 across the warmdown.
Keep a float32 EMA (decay 0.999) of model parameters starting at step 100 and load it into the model just before the final evaluation.
Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 so grad accumulation halves (4 to 2 microsteps at device batch 64) and the run gets about twice as many optimizer steps in 300 s.
Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 so each optimizer step is a single 64x2048 microbatch with no gradient accumulation, giving many more steps in 300 s.
Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.
Replace the Muon momentum ramp with a constant 0.9 for the whole run, keeping Nesterov unchanged.
Raise WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.3 (the existing get_weight_decay already decays it linearly to zero with progress).
Add a 1e-4 z-loss (mean squared logsumexp of the softcapped logits) to the cross-entropy during training only.
No-op: attention and MLP output projections are already zero-initialized in init_weights.
Set WARMUP_RATIO=0.03, WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.65 and FINAL_LR_FRAC=0.03 together, keeping the linear warmdown.
Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the 512-wide model uses 8 heads instead of 4; rotary, value-embedding and ve_gate code all derive sizes from n_head and n_embd, so nothing else changes.
Raise UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 and EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9 together.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" so only the final layer uses full context and the other seven use half-context windows.
Increase DEPTH from 8 to 10 (dim 640, 5 heads) and halve DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 (8 grad-accum steps) to stay within 40GB.
Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more of the run is spent at full learning rate.
